title: ReNative3D36S
subtitle: Recompile Nintendo 3DS games for R36S and compatible handhelds
romHint: Formats: .3ds, .cci or .cia. CIA files may require aes_keys.txt.
outHint: A separate folder named after each game will be created.
footer: ReNative3D36S v0.2.0 · experimental · Pocket Native open source · own ROM dumps only
latest: Pocket Native is up to date
offline: Unable to check GitHub. Cached engine may still work.

copyInfo: Copy BOTH the game folder and the adjacent .sh launcher into roms/ports (or roms2/ports) on the R36S SD card.
missingRom: Choose an existing ROM before recompiling.
supportText: Donations are optional. All features remain free.
dockerSharingError: Docker cannot mount the game or output drive. Open Docker Desktop, wait until it is running, and allow access to the ROM and destination folders. In some versions use Settings > Resources > File Sharing; WSL2 may handle sharing automatically. Retry after resolving permissions.
selectLibrary: Select a game in your library.
kitNotReady: Pocket Native has not been installed yet.
logsCleared: Log panel cleared. The log file was preserved.
updatesInfo: Engine and profiles can be updated independently of the Windows application. Engine changes may require recompiling previously built games.
updatesNoticeText: The app saves the previous engine version. Previously built games are not updated automatically.
libraryHint: Game folders found in your selected output directory. Double-click to open.
settingsInfo: Windows language is detected automatically. Your manual choice is remembered.
settingsHelpText: Start Docker Desktop and wait for the engine to be ready. Grant access to the ROM and output folders if prompted. Check the official Pocket Native instructions when troubleshooting.
progressHint: Progress indicates build stages, not elapsed or remaining time.
languageHint: Language is detected from Windows. You can change it manually.
confirmCleanCache: Delete the reusable Docker compilation cache? Your next game build may take longer. Your ROMs, finished games, and saves will NOT be deleted.
dockerNotReady: Start Docker Desktop and wait until the engine is ready.
cacheBusy: The cache is in use or cannot be removed. Check the log.
enginePageIntro: Only engines that are actually configured can execute. Selecting one does not guarantee game compatibility.
engineConfigIntro: Choose a local Pocket Native-compatible fork or a recomp3ds.exe you obtained and installed yourself. External engines are not redistributed.
engineInvalidFork: Folder is missing required compatible files (Cargo.toml, scripts/container/inside.sh, Containerfile, tools/title_id.py).
engineResearchText: ScarletNX 3DS: experimental, no complete gameplay; GPLv3. Azahar: a 3DS emulator, not a static recompiler; GPLv3. Neither is redistributed.
engineStatusOfficial: OFFICIAL • Build supported with Docker/Podman and compatible ROMs
engineStatusOptimized: IN DEVELOPMENT • No tested ReNative Optimized engine exists; building is disabled.
engineStatusForkReady: EXPERIMENTAL • Fork structure found; execution and compatibility unverified.
engineStatusForkMissing: NOT CONFIGURED • Select a compatible fork folder in the Engines page.
engineStatusZakuroReady: EXTERNAL • Windows executable found; requires a C compiler and Zakuro.
engineStatusZakuroMissing: NOT CONFIGURED • Select the official recomp3ds.exe / 3dsrecomp.exe.
engineDetailOfficial: Builds for R36S/ArkOS with whovian64/pocket-native. Official updates are independent from this frontend. Not every game boots.
engineDetailOptimized: Reserved for a future custom optimized fork; this version contains no embedded experimental engine code.
engineDetailFork: Runs the fork’s scripts/container/inside.sh with isolated Docker build cache. Does not modify or update the fork. Requires R36S testing. CIA mode disabled.
engineDetailZakuro: Runs 3dsrecomp build on Windows using decrypted .3ds/.cci. Library output is managed by Zakuro/3dsrecomp, NOT an R36S folder.
engineTargetPc: Target: Zakuro for Windows; output handled by 3dsrecomp.
engineLocalCiaRestriction: For local forks use decrypted .3ds/.cci. Experimental CIA conversion is disabled to avoid changing third-party code.
engineZakuroRomRestriction: The selected 3dsrecomp needs a decrypted .3ds or .cci ROM. Decrypt CIA separately using your own game dumps.
engineZakuroComplete: 3dsrecomp completed. Output is managed by Zakuro; no R36S build was created. See upstream documentation.
engineInvalidRecompiler: Choose the official executable named 3dsrecomp.exe or recomp3ds.exe. Verify its source before running it.
creditsPocket: Pocket Native: maintained by whovian (whovian64), based on Zakuro and 3dsrecomp by fearkov, with attribution to WINDROID-EMU/3dsrecomp. MIT; copyright © 2026 fearkov and © 2026 whovian.
creditsZakuro: Zakuro and 3dsrecomp: created by fearkov. Zakuro is MIT; 3dsrecomp is a separate project which must be obtained and installed by the user. Their executables are not bundled.
